newsitem.title: USA: Cisco slips after-hours following Q2 net.
newsitem.headline: Cisco slips after-hours following Q2 net.

text.p: Shares of Cisco Systems Inc extended their losses after the internet working company reported fiscal second quarter earnings per share that were a penny short of Wall Street estimates.

The share traded as low as 64-1/4 in trades reported after hours following the results, in which the company reported earnings per share in the second quarter of $0.49, compared with a First Call consensus estimate of $0.50. On a pro-forma basis, however, Cisco said its earnings per share was $0.51.
The share had closed down 1-1/8 at 67-1/8 at the end of the Nasdaq market session, prior to the earnings release.

The proforma number excludes one-time items, including acquisition-related write-downs of in-process research and development and gains related to sale of minority stock investments. The year-ago per-share figure was $0.31.
The Cisco results follow general weakness among shares of networking equipment suppliers in recent days.

3Com Corp shares tumbled 3-1/4 to 58-3/4, in its second consecutive sharp decline as part of a 10-point retreat since executives last week warned of a sales slowdown in December, despite a recovery last month. A Deutsche Morgan Grenfell analyst said he had cut 3Com estimates.
